notes: Fixes the Ports tab. In 2.31.0 the Gen1Recomp support shipped but Gen1Recomp itself did not, so the Ports tab did not appear and the console's web page said it was not installed. Gen1Recomp is made by bryanthaboi and they ask that people only take builds from their own GitHub or Discord, so the console now downloads it straight from their latest release and checks it against the checksum they publish with it. Open the console's web page on port 8097, go to the Ports tab, and press Install Gen1Recomp. It needs internet and is about 33 MB. After that your Gen 1 Game Boy ROMs appear as their own tiles the way the release notes described. Also fixed: games now open fullscreen instead of in a window, and updating Gen1Recomp later re-prepares each game once so a tile can never open on the port's "ROM required" screen.
